player_prompt.intro:
O mmoki {player_id} mo Tic Tac Toe ya Wild.
Ka nako ya gago, o ka tsenya 'X' kgotsa 'O' mo seleng se se khutshwane.
O fenya ka go tsenya tharo tse di tshwanang (X kgotsa O) mo tshekatsheking.
O ka fenya le tshwane nngwe.
Tsenya tshoro ya gago ka tsela '[X 4]' go tsenya X mo sekgweng.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Popego ya tshimologo e e sa siamang. Dirisa popego '[X 4]' kgotsa '[O 2]'.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Nomoro ya sele e e sa siamang: {cell}. E tshwanetse go nna magareng ga 0 le 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Go tsamaya go sa amogelesege. Selwana {cell} se setse se tsentswe.

game_action.placed: Mmoki {player_id} o belegetswe tshwane ya gagwe ({mark}) mo seleng {cell}
